The gang goes on a psychedelic mushroom trip at Arthur's Desert Disco Oasis; tensions erupt when Margot decides to go off her meds; Noah and Dan's situationship with Adam turns romantic; Dan and Eliza bond over their shared realization.

The sudden death of Noah and Margot's estranged father brings the gang back to Texas, where Margot starts experiencing grief-induced psychosis; Noah discovers their mother Carolyn has been hiding a secret.
Noah spends Thanksgiving helping his mother Carolyn clean out her hoarder house; Eliza throws a tense dinner party with Margot and Dan to get content for her business.

After Carolyn moves in with them, Noah and Dan try to hide their relationship with Adam; Dan's parents come over on Christmas and pressure them to fast-track the adoption process; Margot reveals she's gone off her meds.

After a month off her meds, Margot experiences a manic episode; Eliza discovers that there may be a complication with her pregnancy; Noah and Dan discover Adam has been harboring a secret that may jeopardize the adoption process.
With their lives and relationships falling apart, everyone is faced with making difficult choices about the future.

With Eliza's due date approaching, Margot checks out of the mental health facility unsure whether she has a home to return to; Noah and Dan must come to a decision about their separation; the gang must face what a baby means for their future.
